page.overview:
What is Magical Menagerie?

The Magical Menagerie was a magical creature shop in North Side, Diagon Alley, across the street from Florean Fortescue's Ice Cream Parlour.

There were cages of pets on display. It was very cramped, noisy and smelly with every inch of wall covered by cages. It sold all kinds of animals — Streelers, Fire Crabs, sleek black rats that were very intelligent, owls, ravens, cats of every colour, Puffskeins, transforming rabbits and much more.

The witch working behind the counter at the Magical Menagerie wore heavy black spectacles and offered advice to customers. The Menagerie was where Ron Weasley bought some Rat tonic for his pet rat, Scabbers, (who was really Peter Pettigrew, hiding in his animagus form) and Hermione Granger got her cat-Kneazle crossbreed, Crookshanks. The saleswoman stated that Crookshanks had been an inhabitant of the store for a long while, as no one wanted him. Crookshanks also proved to be valuable to the trio during the events of the 1993–1994 school year.
